reviews.t: Great product!  Great way to add fullness to thinner eyebrows
reviews.x: This is a great product for natural more full looking eyebrows.  It took a little patience to figure out the best application technique. I love the effect and the long lasting look.  I have darker blonde hair and use the brunette color

reviews.t: Love it! 65 years young and a chemo survivor
reviews.x: Love it! 65 years young and a chemo survivor, this makes all the difference in the world. Full disclosure, I also use the Lavish Lash eye and brow serum. The photo attached is the brow gel and HD mascara only. No eye makeup or eyeliner at all! Not bad, eh?

reviews.t: They all must be the same color.  Awful!
reviews.x: It is too dark for me.  I ordered both the blonde & the brunette because someone said to blend them to get the right color.  I didn't know what to expect so I did.  She must work for the company.  My first order came from Amazon Prime, said it was the brunette, shipping the blonde later.  I used it and it was way too dark.  Today the second part of the order came & couldn't wait to try it.  It was the brunette!!  It is the same color as the first one.  On the end of the tube it says blonde.  NOT

reviews.t: Won't rub off
reviews.x: Do love this product. A little goes a long way. You have to work hard to get the extra product off the wand or it just kinda blobs on your brow. The brush part of the wand is a bit too long. Think it would be a much better product with a brush about 1/4th as long. Need to use a dry eye brow brush to set the product. But after that it does stay on and won't rub off.

reviews.t: This is horrible.. I looked like Oscar the Grouch after ...
reviews.x: This is horrible..I looked like Oscar the Grouch after applying it.  The brunette is almost black.  The gel spreads out everywhere when you are complete and shaping your brow.  I even tried two trials.  The second trial, I wiped the bush clean because I thought that maybe I was putting too much on.  It’s just really really bad.

reviews.t: Stays on!
reviews.x: I ordered the dark brown, which actually IS dark brown, but not black. Too dark for a blonde or light brown brow, but perfect for my not quite black dark brows. Other "brown" brow colors seemed to always be too light, but black is too dark. So the color is perfect. Application took me a while to get the hang of, since I'm generally not good at applying make-up and this is very thick so it's easy to apply too much at first. The product's thickness provides excellent coverage. And it stays

reviews.t: Finally eyebrows all day!
reviews.x: After a mountain of research on Wunderbrow products, I came across all of the recommendations for Blissful Brows and the Duo Eyebrow brush by Keshia to make it work. I couldn’t agree more! I have never been much of a makeup person and was a bit intimidated with semi-permanent makeup since it is prone to sticking on your face for a few days. With sparse eyebrows, at best, I needed makeup and a tool that I could manage as a novice (in my 50’s!) without looking like I had small animals resting on m

reviews.t: Finally I Have More Defined and Thicker Brows!
reviews.x: I have thin blonde eyebrows and wanted a fuller and darker look. This product definitely filled in my brows so they look much thicker and the brunette color darkened them enough but not too much. If you are in between the blonde and brunette color and you want your eyebrows to pop more I would suggest going with brunette. I have been using along with the Harigenics Eyelash and Brow Growth and Brow Enhancer and have noticed that my eyebrows are slightly thicker and have grown in a bare spot I had

reviews.t: Poor quality -- Product ran down my brow to eyes and cheek!
reviews.x: In my opinion, this product is of very poor quality. It was dark and runny. I had thought that once it dried all would be fine and went about my merry way only to later catch a glimpse of myself in a mirror at the office --OMG! I saw dark runny "Blissful Brows" by Hairgenics had streamed down my brows to my eyes and on down my cheek! [[ASIN:B072JX8LV5 Blissful Brows by Hairgenics - One Step Long Lasting Tinted Eyebrow Gel Infused with Fibers for Thick and Full Brows (Brunette)]]

reviews.t: My brows looked like caterpillars. It's just too much going on with ...
reviews.x: This brow gel is very runny bordering on sloppy. It had a very undesirable green tinge to it that was definitely not brunette. It's too dark if you wear a lighter shade of brown normally. If that is the case, don't switch brands. I wanted to save a couple of bucks, but wound up ordering my former brand anyway. My brows looked like caterpillars. It's just too much going on with the applicator and too dark = disaster.

reviews.t: Read feedback -- then you'll have to wing it -- good luck
reviews.x: If your eyebrows are just light and you're looking for color, this "may" work for you.  The bristles on the applicator are short and product is thick so it's very difficult to apply lightly for added color.  I have sparse eyebrows -- this product is not right for me and I wouldn't recommend it to anyone.  You'll have to figure it out for yourself.  I'm hoping I can get my money back.

reviews.t: Lasts one day---
reviews.x: this product lasted one day... no way did it last up to three days... maybe if you do not wash your face/shower/ or come into contact with any water for three days it would last... but it literally rubbed up when I very carefully dried my face very disappointed- total waste of money... but thanks to Amazon return policy I was able to return it live and learn!

reviews.t: I like this brow gel
reviews.x: I like this brow gel, but it is very dark.  I bought the brunette and the first time I used it I had Groucho Marx brows.  Since that first attempt, I have started using a very small amount and putting it on with a q-tip.  It looks very nice once I figured out how to do a subtle application.  I would definitely purchase this item again.

reviews.t: Impressive for thin brows!
reviews.x: This stuff really works! I have barely there eyebrows, both in amount and color (almost clear), but once the Blissful Brows is applied (I used a flat angled brush and a stencil), I have great brows, for the first time, ever!!  The brunette is too dark for me, even as light as I can apply (they were out of blonde and I was worried about the "chalky" review)  but now I need to try blonde for the right color (will pray it's not really chalky), since this stuff works better than anything els

reviews.t: Blissful Brow Review By a Makeup Junkie
reviews.x: While I can appreciate a quality eyebrow pencil and the hair by hair application of drawing in perfected eyebrows, the Blissful Brows wand worked wonders. I recently moved and have my life in boxes. My Blissful Brows arrived at a time where I needed to look put together for work (and life in general). Good idea  But also,  I'm older and my brows aren't all there  so  the coverage I get works  but  I wa

reviews.t: Too dark and color is not flattering
reviews.x: The color is too dark even though it does not look it in the tube.  It did not last all day.  It does come off in the pool or if my face gets oily.  And the color needs to be a better brown.  The colors are too grayish taupe.  My eyebrows are a much prettier brown with reddish tints in them although I am totally a brunette.

reviews.t: Disappointing
reviews.x: This is sloppy and gloopy. The application is a nightmare.  If you try to remove the excess off the brush,  little dark dots fly all over and stick to your sink.  They need to be scrubbed off. No thanks.

reviews.t: Useless for Eyebrows
reviews.x: I used this product for my eyebrows only. It lasted for maybe 2 mos. Zero result. I also would like to mention that when i bought it, it was $6 and change. Now they sell it for $19. Makes you wonder....

reviews.t: This is a great product. Don't use expensive product which I wasted ...
reviews.x: This is a great product. Don't use expensive product which I wasted my cash on. Enjoy this more than Latisse. I notice more thickness not only the only the length. Very pleased. Highly recommend.

reviews.t: Long lasting stays put
reviews.x: This product is one of my favorites!  It’s wax like texture keeps brows styled and lasts throughout the day without needing retouched. I have blonde hair and ordered the brown

reviews.t: The color is beautiful. I love how easily it goes on and ...
reviews.x: The color is beautiful. I love how easily it goes on and how pretty I feel in this! It doesn't get clumpy after more than a week's worth of use. This is a great product!

reviews.t: but i really like the color and consistency of the product
reviews.x: takes some practice to apply, but i really like the color and consistency of the product. It doesn't leave your brows "cakey" like wunderbrow.

reviews.t: So disappointed.
reviews.x: it contains unknown hair and the bottles is very sticky. Even thought the head is off with some plastic gel on it. Honestly. I don’t like it.

claims.text: Many reviewers find the product effective for creating fuller, more defined brows, especially those with thin or sparse eyebrows.
Several reviewers note a learning curve and that application requires practice, patience, or specific techniques to avoid over-application.
A common complaint is that the brunette shade is too dark, with some describing it as nearly black or giving an undesirable look.
Some reviewers report the formula is runny or prone to smearing and running down the face.
A few reviewers mention the product did not last as long as claimed, rubbing off within a day.
